Name: Better Watering Can And Hoe
Author: Aflojack45
Description:
[size=5][center][b]Vanilla﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   Mod [/b]
﻿[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYjI4amg4amo2ZXFlMTBkbXVycXQzcGVmMWhrd2Rrdm8wYXh3Mm1qYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/03rhUmX0bdxP6ERhQL/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img] ﻿[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/iEYGqwB8eNAuftyjYo/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]﻿ [/center]
[center][b]Usage[/b][/center][/size][size=3]First select your mode for your watering can or hoe (without any changes your default will be "tile 1"):[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Select the watering can or hoe in your hotbar.
[*]Press R (You can bind different key in Generic Mod Config Menu)
[*]Dialog box pop up (choices depend on current upgrade level or enchantment).
[*]Select the mode you want.
[*]Now it's working with single click in your selected mode. If you try to charge it only selected mode will be active until you release.
[/list][size=5][b]
[center]Notes[/center][/b][/size][list]
[*]Choice will be saved in-game and after exit.
[*]You can change the mode anytime following the same method.
[/list][list]
[*]Supported languages: [b]English, Hungarian.[/b]
[/list][list]
[*]This mod can work with different save files.
[*]No multiplayer experience. (If you have any please share)
[/list]
[size=5][b][center]Installation[/center][/b][/size][list]
[*]Need Stardew Valley 1.6+ and installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] latest.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change mod config.
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip and copy to your Mods folder. (Delete any previous version of the mod if you used before 2.0 delete whole 'BetterWateringCan' folder)
[*]Start and enjoy the game.﻿
[/list][size=5][b]
Source code[/b][/size][list][*][url=https://github.com/Aflojack/BetterWateringCanAndHoe]GitHub[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Better Watering Can And Hoe
Manifest.Description: This mod make possible to use your tools in your preferred mode. If you want to use with 3x3 always you don't have to wait every time for power-up your tool. You can use it as your single click. You can use with Watering Cans and Hoes too.
Manifest.Author: Aflojack45
